audience: referral program managers who track referrers, leads and rewards in Referral Factory

useCases.title: See which referrers joined a campaign
useCases.text: List the campaigns to find the campaign id. Then search the referrers of that campaign with filters.

useCases.title: Look up a referrer and their referral link
useCases.text: Search for a referrer, for example by email. Then read the referral link, sharing links, referrals and rewards of that person.

useCases.title: Qualify leads that are not qualified yet
useCases.text: List the leads that are not qualified yet, read one lead, then mark it as qualified. Qualification can trigger the rewards set for it.

useCases.title: Check rewards that are due or issued
useCases.text: List the rewards that are due but not yet issued, for all campaigns or for one campaign. The tool does not issue them.

useCases.title: Add a referrer to a campaign
useCases.text: Create a referrer in a campaign, or change the first name or email of an existing one. Send the invitation only when you set notify to true.
